_comment: **Lava tubes seeded through the Age's rock**, buried so they do nothing until something opens them.
Mine into one and it wells lava into the space you just made; a big enough one starts throwing.
**Two sizes in one feature, because one word must name one thing** (Jonah, 2026-09-11: writing
`volcano` and getting volcanoes plus something else is counterintuitive). The interesting question is
whether the one you found will throw: a seam is under `LavaTubes`' sixteen-block threshold and only
seeps, where a nest straddles it. They were two placed features on a code-built layer until the split;
a `random_selector` says the same thing in the one feature a claim can name.
The chance is what the two counts used to be. Seven seams a chunk and one nest every four chunks is
7 : 0.25, so a nest is 0.25/7.25 = 0.034 of the draws and the placement below counts seven.
Targets are vanilla's two stone tags; **the Age's own rock is added by `FeatureShape`** where it is
